source.scopeNote: Artnivå enligt AviList v2026 (20 oktober 2026). Underarter räknas till art; gråkråka och svartkråka är en art. Tamduva ingår i klippduva, inte som extra art. Ospecificerade taxa, skyddade och ännu inte registrerade fynd ingår inte.

partitions.query: dataProviderId=1 AND municipality='Åstorp' AND organismGroup='Fåglar' AND startDate >= '2025-01-01T00:00:00+01:00' AND startDate < '2026-01-01T00:00:00+01:00' AND isPresentObservation=true
dataProviderId=1 AND municipality='Åstorp' AND organismGroup='Fåglar' AND startDate >= '2026-01-01T00:00:00+01:00' AND startDate < '2026-10-30T00:00:00+01:00' AND isPresentObservation=true

source.aggregation: Earliest day per species and year; all public source references on that day; no coordinates or person fields.

taxonomyEvidence.method: Read actual Artfakta child page and immediate parent breadcrumb accessible link; extract exact href. No string-based taxonomy inference.

populationExceptionEvidence.limitation: Taxonomic parenthood does not itself establish wild-origin status; all returned records have isNaturalOccurrence=true, but population exception must remain transparent.
populationExceptionEvidence.treatment: Included as Columba livia under the existing feral-pigeon exception; never an additional species.

source.sourceIdentifiers: taxonId is the source Artfakta identifier, not an AviList taxonomic ID.
